verdict.rationale: Cerebras docs describe a Management API for dedicated endpoints that lets users upload fine-tuned models from an S3 bucket, version them, and deploy them alongside standard models on a private reserved endpoint (cerebras-docs-9, cerebras-docs-10, cerebras-docs-32, cerebras-docs-24). This covers custom fine-tuned weight serving but is gated behind the dedicated/enterprise endpoint offering rather than the standard self-serve API, and there is no mention of LoRA adapter support specifically. Missing for 10: explicit LoRA/adapter upload support, self-serve (non-dedicated) custom-weight serving, and independent/community confirmation of this workflow.
